findings.claim: The change withholds multiple destructive IPC permissions but only tests `graph_clear`, so the denied-permissions acceptance boundary is only partially covered.
findings.evidence: Acceptance requires "denied permissions ... are tested" and the blocking constraint says "Withheld destructive IPC permissions ... fail closed"; `universal-main.json` omits both `entity-graph-tauri:allow-graph-clear` and `entity-graph-tauri:allow-graph-remove-entity`, but the implemented denial paths only invoke/test clear: `examples/tauri-universal/src/features/platform/services/platform-service.ts` calls `this.plugin.commands.clearGraph()`, `examples/tauri-universal/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` defines only `CLEAR_GRAPH`, and `tests/release/v3-tauri-universal-example.test.mjs` only rejects granting `allow-graph-clear`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an application/native denial path and retained evidence for the withheld remove-entity permission, or stop declaring removal as part of the withheld permission boundary for this showcase.
